question: Can a tokenless native relation-keyed, surprise-written associative memory learn unfamiliar role-conditioned causal rules from actual chosen-action consequences, outperforming R102 scalar gated state and the strongest fully trained conventional controls?

lineage.architecture_north_star: Independent tokenless native causal reasoning, persistent relationships, debuggability and low compute; conventional learners only baselines

hypotheses.primary: R103 native relational binding with actual feedback beats strongest fully trained nonengineered conventional comparator on genuinely new unfamiliar rule families across three independent seeds.
hypotheses.mechanism: Relation-keyed online factual contradiction update beats matched ungated memory, shuffled outcomes, zero factual outcomes, cold reset, and R102 scalar gated state with identical source, actions and training steps.
hypotheses.native_specific: Native internal relation memory beats an equal-parameter external relation memory, holding the native core initialization and information fixed.
hypotheses.retention_and_transfer: Positive unfamiliar-rule gains persist across unseen role relabel, cold query, OOD world shift, and actual mid-episode hidden-rule reversal.
hypotheses.causal_identifiability: Each hidden family has a distinct truth function not seen in FIT/VALID and is balanced within every public pivot/time/query-action stratum. No law/probe private truth is learner visible.

new_unseen_semantics_evaluator_only.A_XNOR_B_AND_C: 1-(a XOR (b AND c)), operands are public role-selected +/-1 binary factors
new_unseen_semantics_evaluator_only.A_XNOR_B_OR_C: 1-(a XOR (b OR c)), operands are public role-selected +/-1 binary factors

source.physical_engine: R85 original 224-tick synthetic physical simulator/R86 public truthful action view, independently regenerated from new R103 salts/seed/index/event; public R88 slots and role tags; never call prior scored panel constructor.
source.support_action_schedule: Exactly 8 CALIBRATE and 8 EXPLOIT_POS physically chosen alternating actions; one actual observed factual outcome each, common to all models.
source.query: Independent physical query after 16 factual supports; TRAIN/VALID only one chosen factual query outcome, DEV evaluator-only two paired true query returns with frozen models.
source.source_family_balance: Unseen family selected by (episode_index // 2) % 2; public pivot/time by index parity; query action by floor(index/4)+seed offset. Each public pivot x query-action cell contains both hidden families in equal counts for each seed.
source.reversal: First eight supports use opposite registered unknown operator from the last eight; always genuinely changes at event 8, query uses the latter rule.
source.cold_source: Cold pivot is independent of hidden operator and chosen query-action family.

mechanism.native: Online rule-keyed matrix/slots represent a relation between public physical role/operand cues and actual consequences; each support updates ONLY the local state via reward prediction error and learned gate; outer weights trained by ordinary fixed AdamW on chosen-action FIT observations.
mechanism.memory_state: 16x16 per episode, initialized zero at episode start, 16 factual writes and query-addressed read
mechanism.same_capacity_controls: Relational ungated uses same trainable architecture without residual-driven gate; zero-feedback still receives public action cues, but no rewards; shuffled feedback is deranged within public action/time strata; reset zeros episodic associative state.
mechanism.native_vs_external: Identical 16 factual support observations and same fresh native core initialization, external memory has within 10% trainable adapter capacity and same outer update steps; record active trainable parameters and compute when available.
mechanism.strong_conventional: Fully trained GRU64, role-set64, flattened MLP64 and static prior, same factual information, action schedule, FIT indices, optimizer budget; strongest comparator selected only post-training for frozen scoring.
mechanism.R102_control: Existing tokenless R102 scalar contradiction-gated model, fresh R103 initialization trained from scratch on R103 source, NEVER R102 trained weights or scored episodes.

engineering.qualify: Existing G4 full CPU Linux/Windows then G5 native authentic TTT and G7 Mamba2 exact SHA
engineering.allowed_unit_only: R103 UNIT_ONLY salt distinct from all original scored salts
